entries.zh: 主掌；掌管主持（治理、支配）
entries.en: to govern; to preside over, to direct

entries.zh: 主宰；支配统辖
entries.en: to govern; to dominate, to rule as master

entries.zh: 统辖；统领部属（使其归隶）
entries.en: to command and rule over; to bring subordinates under control

entries.zh: 合管；共同管辖
entries.en: to govern jointly; to administer together

entries.zh: 合权；总揽权柄（治理一司法辖区）
entries.en: to hold combined authority; to govern a jurisdiction

entries.zh: 政治；治理政务（“攻”字原文有疑，或即“政”）
entries.en: to govern with judgment (headword reads judicito/juridicito); political governance
entries.notes: 首字声调号污损（T99），且攻/政二字与西语词头两读（judicito/juridicito）均存疑，取“政治/治理”义。

entries.zh: 权常义日（权、常义、日，字面照录，疑非成词）；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: authority, constancy, righteousness, day (literal transcription only); 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头涂改难辨（loshiriendo/sohiyendo 两读），汉字“權常義日”不成常词，仅能字面照录，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 权坚几时（一作“权衡几时”，字面照录）；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: authority firm/weighed — until what time (literal transcription only); 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 词头与音写均涂改难辨（sohiyendo/loshiriendo、堅/衡、quia/quian 诸两读），且声调号污损（T99）。

entries.zh: 对针；依罗盘针掌舵定向行船
entries.en: to steer by the compass needle; to navigate the ship according to the compass
entries.notes: 西语词头 aguia/aguja 两读，均指罗盘针（aguja），语义仍稳但词头拼写存疑。

entries.zh: 对针路；按罗盘针路行船（航海依针路而行）
entries.en: to steer the ship according to the compass; to sail by the compass course (needle-route)

entries.zh: 大王；君王（治理土民之主，Governador）
entries.en: great king; sovereign governor (king-like ruler)
entries.notes: 首字声调号污损（T99）且音写 Soa/Toa 有疑；“大王”义本身清晰，按纪律列低置信待复核。

entries.zh: 上界；天界主宰（第一治天者）
entries.en: first governor of heaven; the uppermost realm

entries.zh: 治天下；人世主宰（次治天下者）
entries.en: second governor of the world; to rule all under heaven

entries.zh: 中界；空中主宰（司气天者）
entries.en: governor of the air; the middle realm

entries.zh: 下界；大地主宰（司地者）
entries.en: governor of the earth; the lower realm

entries.zh: 三界；旁注谓“三师”（三教）自称导治天下（一说八神）
entries.en: the three realms; margin note: the “three doctors” (doctrines) who claim to guide and govern the whole world (alt. reading “eight gods”)
entries.notes: 西语词头 dedo locria 疑为 de todo lo criado，旁注 3 doctores/8 dioses 两读并存。

entries.zh: 土王；土民之王（如治理土人之君长）
entries.en: native king; king/governor over the indios (local ruler)

entries.zh: 王娘；女主（Governadora，女王或王之母后）
entries.en: female governor; queen (king's consort or mother)

entries.zh: 当权；当政掌权者
entries.en: to be in power; one holding governing authority
entries.notes: 西语词头 genreegrine 难解（疑为 gente e reino）；汉字“當權”与音写互证清晰，取当权义。

entries.zh: 爵位；官阶尊号（旁注：dignidad、officio，尊位官职）
entries.en: rank and title (of nobility); dignity, office
entries.notes: 词头 Gouiermo 疑为 Gobierno（治理/政体），取“爵位”本义并以官话栏 dignidad officio 佐证。

entries.zh: 紊乱；纷乱失序（“紊”字原文有疑，或作“纷”）
entries.en: disorder, confusion, disarray
entries.notes: 西语词头 desperatad/desperado 与汉字“紊乱”不协；汉字与闽南音写（bûn loān）互证清晰，取紊乱义。
